title: icw-tacoma-1995-world-heavyweight
label: Magus

won.source: Already champion when the held record's one surviving complete card opens; the title win itself pre-dates the recovered record. "Bad Boy" Mark Bagwell is billed the same night as the belt's first-ever champion, and Curt Crane's own on-air recap places his own ICW World Title win at the fed's "ICW Blood Bowl" tournament (1996) -- neither document narrates how the belt reached Magus.

note: Successfully defended against Royal Rumble winner Todd Newkirk at Season Beating's, 17 January 1997.

title: icw-tacoma-1995-north-american
label: "Total Package" Peter Bell

won.source: The broadcast's own commentary: the International Championship is announced vacated ahead of this match, its winner to be crowned with a new North American belt; Bell, introduced as the reigning International/North American champion, retained by disqualification over Brian Anthony.

note: The title's first recorded holder under the North American name; its International-championship predecessor is not separately dated in the held record.

title: icw-tacoma-1995-light-heavyweight
label: "ShotGun" Chris Scott

won.source: Already champion when introduced for his Season Beating's defence against Curt Crane; no earlier title-change document survives in the held record.

note: Defending against Curt Crane at Season Beating's, 17 January 1997; the surviving text breaks off mid-match with no result recorded.

title: icw-tacoma-1995-world-tag-team
label: Boxoffice Bound

won.source: Won the tournament final over Damage Incorporated at Season Beating's after Zulu Nation's interference; Ron Tenille pinned Eddy Ramos.

note: The title's first recorded champions in the held record.
